summary: [¶] Petition under Section 79 (1) (c) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulations 41 and 42 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the Inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 inter alia seeking relaxation of the Regulation 11A read with Regulation 5.8 (xi) pertaining to submission of documents demonstrating ownership of land for return of Bank Guarantee submitted under Regulation 5.8(xi)(c) as well as relaxation of the conditions stipulated for submission of documents pertaining to Financial Closure with regards to 288 MW connectivity at Koppal-II pooling station. [¶] The Petitioner, Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (hereinafter referred to [para 2] 2. The matter was called out for the hearing for admission on 7.8.2025. During the [¶] course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission to [¶] withdraw the present Petition and submitted that an affidavit in this regard has already been placed on record. [para 3] 3. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 2.8.2025, has submitted that the Respondent, Central Transmission Utility of India Limited (CTUIL), has accepted the land and financial closure documents in the name of the SPV, TP Vardhaman Surya Limited (“TPVSL”), pursuant to the directions of the Commission in Petition No. 453/MP/2025 and CTUIL vide its letter dated 7.7.2025 has released the Bank Guarantee of Rs. 28.8 crores along with Financial Closure for the Project achieved on 30.6.2025 without any deficiencies. Accordingly, the Petitioner has sought permission to withdraw the instant Petition. [para 4] 4. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner during the course of the hearing and the affidavit dated 2.8.2025, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition. [para 5] 5. Accordingly, Petition No. 613/MP/2025 is disposed of as withdrawn.
